checkpoint.gameMemory: Unsaved game memory excluded; no game input, settings mutation or foreground control

scenario.scope: Desktop actual-owner public layout/API lifecycle model; native engine/taint/rendering separate
scenario.warmup: One excluded baseline/candidate each;five alternating bounded pairs
scenario.settings: Native presets; existing custom names; deleted FluxUI after saved/applied marker; recovery records
scenario.profiler: None; no profiler preferences changed; hardware/addon-list matched CPU/memory/frame-time/latency unavailable
scenario.interpretation: Baseline stops at applied marker and leaves missing profile absent. Candidate checks actual layout existence, recreates once and preserves existing custom/profile/recovery data. No FPS improvement claim.
scenario.resources: No new frames/hooks/events/tickers/OnUpdates. One existence scan on existing layout events; save/delete requests use existing coalescing/combat/editor queues. Legacy retirement is not repeated during recreation.
